title: Tidy / Room to Think
premise: Launch film for Tidy, a fictional app: one buried cursor snaps hundreds of windows back into place.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Fictional Tidy software. 160/160 counts exactly 160 procedurally drawn UI windows; final 1 denotes one workspace, not a performance claim.
